question: Show revenue by year.
referenceSql: SELECT cal.[Year], SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Calendar AS cal ON cal.[Date] = o.OrderDate GROUP BY cal.[Year] ORDER BY cal.[Year]
